description: This file defines the `LocalVectorStore` class, which provides FAISS-based vector storage with methods for adding embeddings, searching, saving, loading, and retrieving statistics. It manages an index of vectors and associated metadata, supporting similarity search and persistence of data.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A FAISS-based local vector store for managing embedding vectors and their metadata, supporting add, search, persistence, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: __init__(self, dimension: int = 3072)
methods.description: Initializes the vector store with a specified dimension, creating a FAISS index and metadata list.

methods.name: None add_embeddings( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )
methods.description: Adds a list of embedding vectors and their corresponding metadata to the index.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search( self, query_embedding: List[float], k: int = 5, filter_chapter: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Performs a similarity search for a query embedding, with optional filtering by chapter, returning the top k results.

methods.name: None save(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Saves the index and metadata to disk at the specified path.

methods.name: bool load(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Loads the index and metadata from disk from the specified path, returning True if successful.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_stats(self)
methods.description: Returns statistics about the vector store, including total vectors, dimension, and total metadata entries.

ctags.signature: ( self, embeddings: List[List[float]], metadata_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] )

ctags.name: search
ctags.signature: ( self, query_embedding: List[float], k: int = 5, filter_chapter: Optional[int] = None )
